option_a_platform_scheduler_only.description: Rely strictly on AlarmManager PendingIntent lookup and UNUserNotificationCenter getPendingNotificationRequests.
cons: Asynchronous querying on Android can cause transient UI flicker for active toggle states

option_b_full_room_swiftdata_schema.description: Add new Room entities and SwiftData models (`scheduled_reminders` table) with DAOs and migrations.
cons: Massive over-engineering for a 15-minute departure alert
Orphan risk if user clears app alarms via system settings

option_c_lightweight_active_reminder_sto.description: Platform OS scheduler owns the execution alarm. A lightweight SharedPreferences / UserDefaults store tracks active reminder IDs (`rem_tr_route10_0830_15m`) for immediate synchronous UI rendering.
pros: Zero Room / SwiftData schema churn or migrations
Immediate synchronous UI state binding ('Remind me' vs 'Reminder active')
Automatic pruning when reminder fires or route is cancelled
